notes: Questions created in the calendar month (UTC), counted from the /2.3/questions endpoint with filter total. Counts are as of the fetch date, so questions deleted later are not included. The current month is excluded; the last two complete months are refetched on every run. Owner-approved primary comparison sites (selected 2026-11-17): Home Improvement (diy), Travel (travel), Role-playing Games (rpg), Science Fiction & Fantasy (scifi). Each site starts at its first full month after open beta (a partial opening month would distort year-over-year changes). Selection record: review/cd1-comparison-site-selection.md
